For example, my understanding is that the work might look something like this: Local SEO: Google Business Profile optimization, local landing pages, citation management, review management, local link building, and location-based keyword research. B2B SEO (manufacturing, industrial, wholesale, etc.): Optimizing product and application pages, keyword research around technical products and industry terminology, improving site architecture, technical SEO, and creating content around specific products, materials, specifications, and use cases. SaaS SEO: Programmatic SEO, comparison and alternative pages, feature and use-case pages, content hubs, product-led content, and managing indexation for large numbers of URLs. Ecommerce SEO: Product and category page optimization, faceted navigation, handling duplicate and thin pages, structured data, internal linking, crawl budget management, and large-scale product catalog optimization. For example, how difficult would it be for someone experienced in local or B2B SEO to transition into SaaS or ecommerce SEO? Are there any specializations where experience in another area gives you a significant advantage, or where the learning curve is particularly steep?
